prompt: In this photorealistic photo, the chaotic energy of a theatre backstage is captured in sharp detail. On the far left, a woman in a velvet dress stands with her arms crossed, looking at a man in a tuxedo who is adjusting his bowtie next to her. A brown leather suitcase sits on the floor beside the woman in the velvet dress, its brass latches gleaming under the harsh work lights. Center stage left, a dancer in pink tights stretches her leg high against a wooden beam, while a stagehand in blue overalls hands her a water bottle. The stagehand in blue overalls is also looking at a clipboard held by a director in a black beret. To the right of the director in the black beret, a cat with white paws sleeps peacefully on a stack of script binders. A musician with a violin case leans against the wall near the cat with white paws, tapping his foot impatiently. In the center background, an actor in a knight costume sits on a wooden crate, polishing a silver sword. Next to the actor in the knight costume, a makeup artist with a brush applies powder to the cheek of a young girl in a fairy costume. The young girl in the fairy costume holds a small wand tightly in her right hand. A spotlight fixture hangs from the ceiling above the actor in the knight costume, casting a distinct shadow on the floor. On the far right, a technician in a headset points at a tangled mass of cables on the ground. A large prop tree stands next to the technician in the headset, its painted leaves slightly peeling. Behind the prop tree, a ghost light bulb glows softly on a stand. A wardrobe rack filled with colorful costumes is positioned between the dancer in pink tights and the prop tree. An older man in a grey suit walks past the wardrobe rack, checking his wristwatch. A coffee cup rests on top of the brown leather suitcase on the left. There is no audience visible in the frame. There is no natural sunlight entering the space. There is no digital screen or monitor displaying information.
